MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  JANUARY 20, 2026

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  A regular meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
  Estates was called to order at 7:00 p.m. at City of Rolling Hills Estates Council Chamber,
  4045 Palos Verdes Drive N, Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR PERSICHINA.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR PERSICHINA led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Persichina,  Pope,  Ciarolla,  Johnson,
  Holdsworth, and McCormick

  Commissioners Absent:  Bain

  City Staff Present:  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Community Services Coordinator Matt Morrow

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF
  DECEMBER 17, 2025

  VICE CHAIR POPE made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  HOLDSWORTH to:

  APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  DECEMBER 17, 2025.

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  NONE.

  6.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  COMMISSIONER POPE moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  HOLDSWORTH, TO ADJOURN TO THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION
  ADVISORY BOARD MEETING.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  1
JANUARY 20, 2026
   **ADJOURNED TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MEETING AT
  7:01 PM**

  A.  ADVISORY BOARD REVIEW OF PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ANNUAL
  REPORT

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave an overview of the Pepper Tree Foundation Annual
  Report (as per the agenda material).

  VICE CHAIR POPE commended Staff for their work managing expenses.

  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  CIAROLLA to:

  RECEIVE AND FILE THIS REPORT.

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  COMMISSIONER HOLDSWORTH moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  MCCORMICK, TO RECONVENE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
  MEETING.

  **RECONVENED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING AT 7:05 PM**

  B.  2026 SUMMER MOVIE NIGHTS PROGRAM

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief overview of the 2026 Summer Movie Nights
  program (as per the agenda material).

  In response to VICE CHAIR POPE, Coordinator Morrow stated that attendance for
  the movie nights has remained consistent the past few years with August having
  more in attendance than in June with an estimated 75-100 people in attendance.

  In response to COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK, Coordinator Morrow noted that
  the June movie night attendance is closer to 75 people.

  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK asked if Staff could track the attendance
  numbers for the movie nights as best as possible.

  In response to VICE CHAIR POPE, Coordinator Morrow stated that movie nights
  typically get one sponsor to help cover some of the costs.

  VICE CHAIR POPE  made  a  motion,  seconded  by  COMMISSIONER
  MCCORMICK to:

  APPROVE STAFF RECOMMENDATION FOR THE TWO MOVIES TO BE
  SHOWN FOR THE 2026 SUMMER MOVIE NIGHT PROGRAM.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  2
JANUARY 20, 2026
   There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  C.  2026 CONCERT IN THE PARK EVENT

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief overview of the 2026 Concert in the Park event
  (as per the agenda material).

  In response to VICE CHAIR POPE, Coordinator Morrow stated that the 2023
  concert had the best attendance out of the four concerts that have been held. He
  noted that the 2025 concert had a similar number of attendees and that it is
  estimated that there were 175 in attendance.

  COMMISSIONER JOHNSON asked what the cost of the band typically is.
  Supervisor Pinuelas stated that $2,500 is budgeted for the cost of the band.

  VICE CHAIR POPE asked about the marketing of the concert in the park event
  and if the COMMISSION could assist with social media posting/reposting to help
  boost event attendance. Supervisor Pinuelas stated that the Commission could
  assist with reposting social media marketing.

  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK noted that it may be good to incorporate some
  family friendly activities at the event to assist in bringing in more families.

  In response to CHAIR PERSICHINA, Supervisor Pinuelas stated that the park
  could handle roughly 500 in attendance for the event based on previous larger
  events held at the park.

  VICE CHAIR POPE  made  a  motion,  seconded  by  COMMISSIONER
  HOLDSWORTH to:

  APPROVE STAFF RECOMMENDATION TO SECURE THE BAND RADIO
  ROYALTY TO PERFORM AT THE 2026 CONCERT IN THE PARK.

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  D.  2026 PROPOSED PARK TOUR SCHEDULE

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief overview of the 2026 proposed park tour schedule
  (as per the agenda material).
  COMMISSIONER HOLDSWORTH made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR
  POPE to:

  APPROVE THE 2026 PROPOSED PARK TOUR SCHEDULE.

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  7.  STAFF ITEMS

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  3
JANUARY 20, 2026
   A.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.
  8.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  COMMISSIONER JOHNSON asked if any commissioners could switch or cover
  her for attending the February 10 City Council meeting as she is unable to attend
  due to a prior engagement.

  9.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF DECEMBER 16, 2025

  VICE CHAIR POPE  made  a  motion,  seconded  by  COMMISSIONER
  HOLDSWORTH to:

  RECEIVE AND FILE.

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  10.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR PERSICHINA ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 7:20 PM TO THE NEXT
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON FEBRUARY 17, 2026, AT
  7:00 P.M., WHICH WILL BE HELD IN THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CITY
  HALL.

  There being no objection, so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  ___________________________  ___________________________
  Matt Morrow  Lou Persichina
  Community Services Coordinator  Chair, Park & Activities Commission

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  4
JANUARY 20, 2026
